title: 第13章  谢剑疯了，秘密似乎藏不住了
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
堂堂合欢宗内门弟子，半步筑基的天才，就这样像条死狗一样，被李长生随手捏死在了自家院子前。
片刻……
李长生松开手。
尸体扑通一声掉在地上。
他看都没看一眼。
熟练地取下沈醉的储物袋和那把白骨折扇。
想了想。
就做了一个违背道德的决定。
既然谢剑派了沈醉进来试探。
那我也可以用沈醉来试探谢剑。
李长生提起沈醉的尸体，身形一闪，消失在夜色中。
第二天清晨。
安置区的中心广场上。
一根旗杆插在中央，旗杆顶端，挂着一具尸体。
尸体身穿粉色锦袍，随风摇晃。
虽然面容已经有些扭曲，但依然能认出来，那正是昨晚闯入安置区的合欢宗弟子沈醉。
而在尸体的胸口上。
写着几个血淋淋的大字：
“合欢宗魔修。”
“该诛！”

字迹苍劲有力，透着凛冽的剑意。
最先发现的是安置区的苏员外。
苏员外祖上也是青云宗被优化的弟子，但是因为修炼资质薄弱，建立凡人家族之后，就没有再踏入仙路，而是做起了凡人的生意。
安置区的坊市中就有一大半生意都是苏家的。
苏员外正准备去自己的米仓看看，路过中央广场时，看到了这一幕，禁不住惊呼一声：
“死人了。”
“死人了啊！”
随着苏员外的惊呼，周围的老头
看着挂在高杆上的男子。
禁不住倒吸一口气。
“这是羊肉串吗？”
“将人从屁股穿进去，从嘴巴出来。这也太残忍了吧？”
“残忍个锤子。”
“难道你没有看到其身上的字吗？【合欢宗魔修】。”
“咱们安置区不是被封锁了吗？合欢宗的人怎么进来安置区的？”
“我现在只想知道是谁干的？”
“按照残留的灵力判断，合欢宗魔修应该是半步筑基修为，到底是谁杀了他？谁又有能力能杀了他？”
“难道我们安置区里，还藏着绝世高手？”
所有人都围在广场上，指指点点，议论纷纷。
更有一丝莫名的兴奋。

被压抑了这么久，被屠杀了这么久。
终于有人站出来反击了。
而且一出手就捏死了一个合欢宗的弟子。
这无疑给所有幸存者打了一针强心剂。
李长生也躲在人群中，见事情正在向自己预测的方向发展，心头禁不住有些得意。半步筑基死在安置区，而且找不到凶手，那幕后的人肯定会越来越猜忌的。这些都是机会啊！
或许我可以。
李长生一想到这里，一股灵力覆盖在喉咙上，发出一阵嘶哑的声音。
“说不定是谢剑长老干的呢？”
谁也不知道这句话从哪里传出来的。
但是一传出来。
众人愣了一下，竟然直接认可了这句话。
“对啊！”
“谢剑长老不是说封闭安置区，击杀魔门弟子吗？”
“这合欢宗的弟子肯定是谢剑长老杀的。”
“对。”
“就是仙门长老杀的。”
“魔头已除，感恩谢剑长老。”
“各位，我突然想到一个问题，既然魔头已除，岂不是可以解封了？”
“什么时候撤去阵法啊？”
“同问，什么时候撤去阵法啊？”

“我不想像个犯人一样，被关在这里。”
安置区人群逐渐沸腾了起来。
很多人认为魔门已除。
可以解除封闭了。
有些修士已经闹起来了。
与此同时。
谢剑正在青云宗外门密室修炼，密室是红色的，四周带着诡异纹路。
吐纳间气息不断提升。
如今……
他的修为已经筑基巅峰了。
那位大人真厉害。
随便指点两下，就能获得如此恐怖的提升。
谢剑非常高兴。
同时对那位大人也越发畏惧了。
正在此时。
传音符忽然震动了起来。
谢剑看着震动的传音符，皱了皱眉头。
胖护法为什么在这时候加急联系我？
我不是让沈醉去解决安置区的麻烦了吗？
难道出事了？

谢剑一想到这里，顿时无心修炼。
刚上来到客厅。
顿时看到，胖瘦两位护法，分别站立两旁。
他们看到自己出现，焦急地开口：
“长老。”
“出事了。”
“沈公子死了。”
谢剑闻言，脸部肌肉一抽，声音难以置信：
“你再说一遍？”
“谁死了？”
胖护法被谢剑吃人般眼神吓得浑身一颤，扑通一声跪倒在地，冷汗打湿了后背，颤颤巍巍地回答：
“回长老……”
“是沈公子。”
“现在沈公子的尸体现在就挂在安置区的中心广场上。”
“死状极其凄惨。”
谢剑闻言，一掌拍在身旁的红木桌子上，桌子瞬间化为齑粉。
怎么回事？
沈公子也死了？
他是知道沈醉的修为的。
修为已达半步筑基，即便一般筑基修为的弟子，也能一战。在安置区谁能杀得了他？

“怎么死的？”谢剑假装镇定地问。
“沈公子被人暴力拧断脖子，一招致命。”
胖护法如实回答。
一招毙命？
杀半步筑基都已经很难了。
而且还是秒杀。
安置区那群老头，不可能有这个实力的。
难道真的有其他势力插手了？亦或者是仙门其他修士插手了？
谢剑想到这里，脸色就越发深沉。
沈醉死了。
不仅仅是一个合欢宗弟子死了简单。
沈醉是合欢宗那边派来的联络人。
沈醉是知道那位大人的一部分计划的人，若是沈醉死前吐露了什么，或者被搜魂……会对那位大人的计划造成很大影响的。
想着想着，谢剑感觉一股寒意从脚底直冲天灵盖。若是破坏了那位大人的计划的话，那位大人都不知道会有多生气呢！
“谁干的？”
“查出来没有？”
谢剑猛地停下脚步，眼神如鹰隼般锐利。
瘦护法连忙上前，拱手道：
“回长老，没有。”
“不过……”

“如果将尸体带回来，应该能看出点什么。而且凶手在尸体上留了字，说明其极其傲慢和嚣张。”
“尸体上留了什么字？”谢剑想了想问。
“合欢宗魔修，该诛！”
谢剑闻言，瞳孔微缩。
凶手知道沈公子的身份了？
那就更麻烦了。
先是两个白手套死亡，然后沈公子死亡。
这一切都说明了安置区脱离了自己的控制。
有未知的力量在插手安置区的事情。
看来这件事要告诉那位大人才可以。
胖护法小心翼翼地问道：
“长老，现在怎么办？”
“安置区那边闹得很凶。”
“都在说是长老您除了魔修，吵着要解封。”
谢剑愣了一下：“他们说沈公子是我杀的？”
胖护法回答：“是的。”
谢剑闻言，脸色更加难看了。
这锅怎么就扣在我头上了呢？
他总感觉有一双无形的大手，正在操控着事情的发展，但是又没有证据。
这锅他不敢背。

却又不得不背。
谢剑想了一会，顿时开口：
“那你就告诉安置区的老头，沈公子是我杀的吧！”
“同时。”
“将沈公子的尸体带回来。”
胖护法：“那他们闹解封的事情怎么办？”
谢剑声音冷峻：“这都还要我教你吗？直接昭告安置区，说魔修尚未除完，暂时无法解封，望大家谅解。”
谢剑很清楚。
现在已经是骑虎难下。
若是解封，安置区里发生的烂事肯定会传出去。
到时候宗门查下来，他谢剑第一个就要掉脑袋。
不但不能解封，还要将阵法加强，把所有人都困死在里面。
只能一不做二不休了。
胖护法闻言，额头上大汗淋漓，领命而去：“是。”
安置区内。
胖护法带着谢剑长老的法旨，来到广场上，先是安抚众人，将沈公子的尸体带走。然后昭告谢剑长老法旨，魔修未除干净，暂时无法解封，请各位谅解。
胖护法的消息很快传开。
众人议论纷纷。
“谢长老说了，魔修是他杀的。”
“长老威武。”

“长老霸气。”
“感谢长老守护安置区安宁。”
“可是，长老说魔修还没清干净，暂时不能解封，还要我们再等等。”
“我们等等就是了。”
“还要等？这都多久了？”
“算了算了，长老也是为了咱们好。魔修那么凶残，咱们还是老老实实待着吧。”
广场上群情激奋的老修们，听到胖护法带来的【官方解释】，无奈又没有办法。
有人信了，安心回家，等解封。
有人不信，也无可奈何，只能骂骂咧咧地散开。
李长生隐藏在角落里，看着渐渐散去的人群，嘴角勾起一抹讥讽的冷笑。
“魔修未除？”
“暂不解封？”
“呵呵，谢剑啊谢剑，你这如意算盘打得叮当响？想要忽悠谁呢？”
沈公子是我杀的啊！
你居然还愿意替我背锅。
说明其背后所图甚大。
真是有意思啊！
李长生敏锐地感觉到。
随着时间的推移，笼罩在安置区上空的阵法，反而变得更加凝实，更加阴森了，隐隐透出一股令人作呕的血煞之气。
“看来。”

“谢剑是打算破罐子破摔，直接要把这里炼成修罗场了。”
李长生眼神冰冷。
既然你不给活路。
那就别怪我不客气了。
content_en:
A dignified inner disciple of the Hehuan Sect, a genius who was half-stepped to build a foundation, was casually crushed to death by Li Changsheng like a dead dog in front of his yard.
For a moment...
Li Changsheng let go of his hand.
The body plopped to the ground.
He didn't even look at it.
Skillfully removed the drunken storage bag and the white fractured fan.
Think about it.
I made an unethical decision.
Since Xie Jian sent Shen Zui in to test.
Then I can also use Shen Zui to test Xie Jian.
Li Changsheng lifted up the drunk body and disappeared into the night.
Early the next morning.
In the central square of the resettlement area.
A flagpole was stuck in the center, and a corpse hung on the top of the flagpole.
The corpse was wearing a pink brocade robe, swaying in the wind.
Although his face was a little distorted, he could still recognize it as Shen Zui, a disciple of the Hehuan Sect who broke into the resettlement area last night.
And on the chest of the corpse.
There were a few big bloody characters written on it:
"Hehuan Sect Demonic Cultivator."
"Deserves to be punished!"
The handwriting is vigorous and powerful, revealing the cold sword intent.
The first person to be discovered was Yuan Su outside the resettlement area.
Su Yuan's maternal ancestor was also an optimized disciple of the Qingyun Sect, but due to his weak cultivation qualifications, after establishing a mortal family, he did not set foot on the path of immortality again, but started a mortal business.
Most of the businesses in the resettlement area are owned by the Su family.
Member Su was about to go to his rice warehouse to take a look. When he passed by the central square, he saw this scene and couldn't help but exclaimed:
"Dead people."
"He's dead!"
As Su Yuanwai exclaimed, the old men around him
Look at the man hanging on the high pole.
I couldn't help but take a breath.
"Is this mutton kebab?"
"Putting people through the butt and coming out through the mouth. Isn't this too cruel?"
"A cruel hammer."
"Didn't you see the words on his body? [Hehuan Sect Demon Cultivator]."
"Isn't our resettlement area blocked? How did the people from the Hehuan Sect enter the resettlement area?"
"All I want to know now is who did it?"
"Based on the remaining spiritual power, the Hehuan Sect's demon cultivator should be half-step in foundation-building cultivation. Who killed him? Who has the ability to kill him?"
"Is it possible that there are still peerless masters hiding in our settlement area?"
Everyone gathered in the square, pointing and talking.
There was even a hint of inexplicable excitement.
It has been suppressed for so long and massacred for so long.
Finally someone stood up and fought back.
And he killed a disciple of the Hehuan Sect with one move.
This is undoubtedly a shot in the arm for all survivors.
Li Changsheng was also hiding in the crowd. Seeing that things were developing in the direction he predicted, he couldn't help but feel a little proud. Half-step Zhuji died in the resettlement area, and the murderer could not be found, the people behind the scenes would definitely become more and more suspicious. These are all opportunities!
Maybe I can.
When Li Changsheng thought of this, a wave of spiritual power covered his throat, making a hoarse sound.
"Maybe it was Elder Xie Jian who did it?"
No one knows where this sentence came from.
But as soon as it came out.
Everyone was stunned for a moment, and actually directly recognized this sentence.
"Yes!"
"Didn't Elder Xie Jian say that the resettlement area should be closed and the Demon Sect disciples killed?"
"This Hehuan Sect disciple must have been killed by Elder Xie Jian."
"Yes."
"It was the elders of the Immortal Sect who killed him."
"The devil has been eliminated. Thank you, Elder Xie Jian."
"Everyone, a question suddenly occurred to me. Now that the devil has been eliminated, can't it be unblocked?"
"When will the formation be removed?"
"I would like to ask, when will the formation be removed?"
"I don't want to be locked up here like a prisoner."
The crowd in the resettlement area gradually became excited.
Many people believe that the demon door has been eliminated.
The lockdown can be lifted.
Some monks were already making trouble.
at the same time.
Xie Jian is practicing in the secret room of the outer gate of Qingyun Sect. The secret room is red and has strange lines around it..
The breath continues to rise as he breathes in and out.
Nowadays...
His cultivation level has reached the peak of foundation building.
That adult is really awesome.
With just a few pointers, you can get such a terrifying improvement.
Xie Jian was very happy.
At the same time, I became more and more afraid of that adult.
At this moment.
The transmission note suddenly vibrated.
Xie Jian looked at the vibrating transmission notes and frowned.
Why did the Fat Protector contact me urgently at this time?
Didn’t I ask Shen Zui to solve the trouble in the resettlement area?
Did something happen?
When Xie Jian thought of this, he suddenly had no intention of practicing.
Just came up to the living room.
Immediately, he saw two fat and thin guardians standing on both sides.
When they saw themselves appearing, they spoke anxiously:
"Elder."
"Something happened."
"Master Shen is dead."
When Xie Jian heard this, his facial muscles twitched and his voice was unbelievable:
"Say it again?"
"Who died?"
The fat protector was so frightened by Xie Jian's cannibalistic eyes that he trembled, fell to his knees with a plop, his back wet with cold sweat, and replied tremblingly:
"Go back to the elder..."
"It's Mr. Shen."
"Master Shen's body is now hanging in the central square of the resettlement area."
"The death was extremely miserable."
Upon hearing this, Xie Jian slapped his palm on the mahogany table beside him, and the table instantly turned into powder.
What's going on?
Mr. Shen is also dead?
He knew Shenzui's cultivation level.
The cultivation level has reached half step of foundation building, even the disciples with ordinary foundation building cultivation level can fight. Who can kill him in the resettlement area?
"How did you die?" Xie Jian asked pretending to be calm.
"Mr. Shen's neck was violently twisted, and he was fatal with one move."
The fat protector answered truthfully.
Kill with one move?
It is already difficult to kill even half a step to build a foundation.
And it’s still an instant kill.
It is impossible for those old men in the resettlement area to have this strength.
Are there really other forces involved? Or maybe other monks from the Immortal Sect intervened?
Xie Jian's face became darker when he thought of this.
Drunk to death.
It's not just a simple death of a Hehuan Sect disciple.
Shen Zui is the liaison person sent by the Hehuan Sect.
Shen Zui is the one who knows part of that adult's plan. If Shen Zui reveals something before his death, or is soul-searched... it will have a great impact on that adult's plan.
As he thought about it, Xie Jian felt a chill rush from the soles of his feet to Tianling Gai. If that adult's plan was ruined, that adult wouldn't know how angry he would be!
"Who did it?"
"Have you found out?"
Xie Jian stopped suddenly, his eyes as sharp as an eagle.
The skinny protector hurriedly stepped forward, cupped his hands and said:
"Return to the elder, no."
"But..."
"If you bring the body back, you should be able to tell something. Moreover, the murderer left words on the body, which shows that he is extremely arrogant and arrogant."
"What words were left on the body?" Xie Jian asked after thinking for a while.
"The Hehuan Sect's demon cultivator deserves to be punished!"
When Xie Jian heard this, his pupils shrank slightly.
Does the murderer know Mr. Shen’s identity?
That would be even more troublesome.
First, the two white gloves died, and then Mr. Shen died.
All this shows that the resettlement area is out of its control.
There are unknown forces meddling in the resettlement area.
It seems that this matter needs to be told to that adult.
The fat protector asked cautiously:
"Elder, what should we do now?"
"It's very noisy over there in the resettlement area."
"Everyone is saying that you, the elder, are clamoring to unblock the demon cultivator."
Xie Jian was stunned for a moment: "They said I killed Mr. Shen?"
The fat guardian replied: "Yes."
When Xie Jian heard this, his face became even more ugly.
Why is this blame placed on my head?
He always felt that there was a pair of invisible hands controlling the development of things, but there was no evidence.
He didn't dare to take the blame.
But he had to carry it.
Xie Jian thought for a while and suddenly said:
"Then tell the old man in the resettlement area that I killed Mr. Shen!""At the same time."
"Bring Mr. Shen's body back."
Fat Guardian: "Then what should we do about the unblocking issue?"
Xie Jian's voice was cold: "Do you still need me to teach you this? Directly inform the resettlement area that the demonic cultivators have not been eliminated yet and cannot be unsealed for the time being. I hope everyone will understand."
Xie Jian knew it very well.
Now it is difficult to get off the tiger.
If the lockdown is lifted, the bad things that happened in the resettlement area will definitely spread.
When the sect investigates, Xie Jian will be the first to lose his head.
Not only cannot the seal be unsealed, but the formation must be strengthened to trap everyone inside.
We can only do one thing and two things.
When the fat protector heard this, he was sweating profusely on his forehead and followed the order: "Yes."
within the resettlement area.
The fat protector came to the square with Elder Xie Jian's decree. He first comforted everyone and took Mr. Shen's body away. Then he informed Elder Xie Jian of the decree. The demonic cultivators have not been completely eliminated and the seal cannot be unsealed for the time being. Please forgive me.
News of the fat protector spread quickly.
Everyone was talking about it.
"Elder Xie said that the demon cultivator was killed by him."
"The elder is mighty."
"The elder is domineering."
"Thank you to the elders for protecting the peace of the resettlement area."
"However, the elder said that the demonic cultivators have not been cleared yet and cannot be unsealed for the time being, and they want us to wait."
"We'll just wait."
"Still waiting? How long has it been?"
"Forget it, the elder is doing it for our own good. The demon cultivator is so cruel, we should just stay calm."
The excited senior cultivators in the square were helpless and had no other choice when they heard the [official explanation] brought by the fat protector.
Some people believed it and went home with peace of mind until the lockdown was lifted.
Some people didn't believe it and had no choice but to curse and disperse.
Li Changsheng hid in the corner, looking at the crowd gradually dispersing, with a sarcastic sneer on his lips.
"The evil cultivator has not been eliminated?"
"The lockdown will not be lifted yet?"
"Haha, Xie Jian, Xie Jian, are you making such a wishful thinking? Who are you trying to fool?"
I killed Mr. Shen!
You're actually willing to take the blame for me.
It shows that the picture behind it is very big.
How interesting!
Li Changsheng felt it keenly.
As time went by, the formation that shrouded the settlement area became more solid and gloomy, faintly revealing a disgusting blood evil aura.
"It seems."
"Xie Jian is planning to break the jar and turn this place into a Shura field."
Li Changsheng's eyes were cold.
Since you don't give me a way to survive.
Then don't blame me for being rude.
